text:
All requested Gate 2 revisions have been applied to `header.json`, `units-001.json`, and `units-002.json`, and each section has been re-validated and accepted:

1. **`rootRouteRef`**: Replaced all references to `notificationsRouteRef` with `rootRouteRef` from `plugins/notifications/src/routes.ts` in `U09` (rule 7 and `uses`) and `U15` (rule 2 `mountedRoutes: { '/notifications': rootRouteRef }` and `uses`).
2. **`toastApi.post({ title, status })` and translation key alignment**: Updated `header.json` (`mark-as-read error reporting` decision), `U09` (rule 7), and `U15` (rule 5 and error test case) to use `toastApi.post({ title: t('unreadNotificationsCard.errorMarkAsRead'), status: 'danger' })`.
3. **`react-relative-time`**: Updated `U09` (rule 7) to use `<RelativeTime value={notification.created} />` from `react-relative-time` (with `// @ts-ignore` import, matching `NotificationsTable.tsx`) instead of `luxon`.
4. **Package dependencies (`U01` and `U02`)**: Added `"@backstage/frontend-test-utils": "workspace:^"` to `devDependencies` in `U01` (`plugins/notifications/package.json` site `S2`), and added `"@testing-library/dom": "^10.0.0"` alongside `"@testing-library/react": "^16.0.0"` in `U02` (`plugins/home-react/package.json`).
5. **CSS module class in `U07`, `U16`, and `header.json`**: Simplified `U07` (rule 3 and site `S3`) to `className={notification.id === highlightedId ? styles.highlightedRow : undefined}` with no unscoped class or `data-highlighted` attribute, updated the `highlighted row styling in NotificationsTable` decision in `header.json`, and updated `U16` (rule 4) to assert the `'highlightedRow'` class via `identity-obj-proxy`.
